method.scope: Nouvelle-Aquitaine: event flagged regional or attached to an NA department
method.grouping: subject (organisation or victim domain) + shared topic word + 72-hour window
method.independence: publisher host from the source URL; feeds of one publisher count once
method.disagreement: distinct declared severity, or distinct claim nature, between publishers
method.privacy: hashed subject identifiers and event ids only; no title, summary or personal data
method.sources: all sources included, including gray sources; no paid service and no network call
